title: Figuren-Test · Blendkit-Suche nach Trickfilm-Figuren + Animationsbibliothek pruefen

steps.label: Start, Systemcheck
steps.run: echo start; date -u; memory_pressure -Q 2>/dev/null | tail -1; pgrep -fl Blender | head -3; df -h ~ | tail -1; true

steps.label: Skripte schreiben
steps.run:
cat > bksearch.py <<'EOF_S'
# Blendkit search probe (runs headless inside Blender to reuse the logged-in add-on key)
import bpy, os, json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, sys, time
OUT = os.path.abspath("probe"); os.makedirs(OUT + "/thumbs", exist_ok=True)
KEY = ""
for name, ad in bpy.context.preferences.addons.items():
    if "blenderkit" in name.lower(): KEY = getattr(ad.preferences, "api_key", "") or ""
UA = "blenderkit/3.21.3 (Blender 5.2.3)"
QUERIES = ["stylized character", "cartoon character", "stylized character rigged", "cartoon man rigged", "cartoon woman rigged",
           "stylized man", "stylized woman", "toon character", "pixar style", "stylized boy", "stylized girl", "cartoon boy",
           "cartoon girl", "stylized old man", "cartoon businessman", "stylized chef", "character face rig", "animated character",
           "stylized dog", "cartoon dog", "cartoon cat", "stylized cat", "stylized kitchen", "cartoon kitchen", "stylized office", "stylized living room"]
seen = {}; log = []
def get(url, auth=True):
    h = {"User-Agent": UA, "accept": "application/json"}
    if auth and KEY: h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h), timeout=60).read().decode())
first = True
for q in QUERIES:
    url = "https://www.blenderkit.com/api/v1/search/?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"query": q + " asset_type:model order:_score", "dict_parameters": "1", "page_size": "40"})
    try:
        d = get(url)
    except Exception as e:
        log.append("ERR %s %s" % (q, e)); continue
    res = d.get("results", [])
    log.append("Q %-28s n=%d total=%s" % (q, len(res), d.get("count")))
    if first and res:
        json.dump(res[0], open(OUT + "/sample_result.json", "w"), indent=1); first = False
    for r in res:
        aid = r.get("assetBaseId") or r.get("id")
        if aid in seen: seen[aid]["q"].append(q); continue
        dp = r.get("dictParameters") or {}
        files = r.get("files") or []
        blend = next((f.get("downloadUrl") for f in files if f.get("fileType") == "blend"), None)
        th = r.get("thumbnailMiddleUrl") or r.get("thumbnailSmallUrl")
        e = {"i": len(seen), "id": aid, "name": r.get("name"), "q": [q], "lic": r.get("license"), "free": r.get("isFree"),
             "can": r.get("canDownload"), "faces": dp.get("faceCount"), "rig": dp.get("rig") if "rig" in dp else dp.get("rigged"),
             "anim": dp.get("animated"), "style": dp.get("modelStyle"), "mb": round((r.get("filesSize") or dp.get("filesSize") or 0) / 1e6, 1) if isinstance(r.get("filesSize") or dp.get("filesSize"), (int, float)) else None,
             "score": r.get("score"), "rating": r.get("ratingsAverage"), "tags": (r.get("tags") or [])[:12], "blend": blend, "thumb": th,
             "dp": {k: v for k, v in dp.items() if k in ("faceCount", "rig", "animated", "modelStyle", "condition", "designYear", "dimensionX", "dimensionY", "dimensionZ", "shaders", "uv", "pbrType", "textureResolutionMax", "simulation", "particles", "modifiers", "meshPolyType", "manufacturer", "designer", "productionLevel")}}
        seen[aid] = e
        if th:
            try:
                p = OUT + "/thumbs/%03d.jpg" % e["i"]
                with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(th, headers={"User-Agent": UA}), timeout=30) as rr: open(p, "wb").write(rr.read())
            except Exception as ex: log.append("thumb fail %d %s" % (e["i"], ex))
json.dump(list(seen.values()), open(OUT + "/results.json", "w"), indent=1)
open(OUT + "/search_log.txt", "w").write("key=%s\n" % bool(KEY) + "\n".join(log))
print("BKSEARCH done", len(seen), flush=True)
EOF_S
ls -la bksearch.py
cat > ualinfo.py <<'EOF_U'
# Inspect Quaternius UAL files: import every glb/fbx found, list armatures, bone names, actions, meshes, shape keys
import bpy, os, sys, glob
argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
root = argv[0]; out = argv[1]
L = []
files = sorted(glob.glob(root + "/**/*.glb", recursive=True) + glob.glob(root + "/**/*.gltf", recursive=True))
if not files: files = sorted(glob.glob(root + "/**/*.fbx", recursive=True))
L.append("FILES %d" % len(files))
for f in files[:6]:
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    try:
        if f.endswith(".fbx"): bpy.ops.import_scene.fbx(filepath=f)
        else: bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=f)
    except Exception as e:
        L.append("IMPORT FAIL %s %s" % (f, e)); continue
    L.append("== %s" % os.path.relpath(f, root))
    for o in bpy.data.objects:
        extra = ""
        if o.type == "MESH":
            extra = "verts=%d sk=%s mats=%s" % (len(o.data.vertices), [k.name for k in o.data.shape_keys.key_blocks][:20] if o.data.shape_keys else None, [m.name for m in o.data.materials if m][:6])
        L.append("OBJ %s %s dim=%s %s" % (o.type, o.name, tuple(round(v, 2) for v in o.dimensions), extra))
        if o.type == "ARMATURE":
            L.append("BONES %d: %s" % (len(o.data.bones), ", ".join(b.name for b in o.data.bones)))
    L.append("ACTIONS %d" % len(bpy.data.actions))
    for a in bpy.data.actions:
        L.append("ACT %s %s" % (a.name, tuple(round(x) for x in a.frame_range)))
open(out, "w").write("\n".join(L))
print("UALINFO", len(files), flush=True)
EOF_U
ls -la ualinfo.py

steps.label: Blendkit: stilisierte Figuren suchen + Vorschaubilder laden
steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P bksearch.py > search.log 2>&1; tail -3 search.log; cat probe/search_log.txt | head -40; ls probe/thumbs | wc -l

steps.label: Quaternius-Animationsbibliothek (CC0) laden und pruefen
steps.run: mkdir -p ual && cd ual && for u in universal_animation_librarystandard universal_animation_library_2standard; do [ -f $u.zip ] || curl -fsSL -o $u.zip https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/$u.zip; mkdir -p $u && (cd $u && unzip -oq ../$u.zip); done; ls -la; find . -type f | grep -v -i -E '\.(png|jpg)$' | head -80 > ../ual_list.txt; cat ../ual_list.txt | head -40; cd .. && for u in universal_animation_librarystandard universal_animation_library_2standard; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ualinfo.py -- $PWD/ual/$u $PWD/ualinfo_$u.txt > ualinfo_$u.log 2>&1; tail -2 ualinfo_$u.log; head -c 3000 ualinfo_$u.txt; done; true

steps.label: Ergebnisse fuer Claude bereitstellen
steps.run: tar czf probe2501.tgz probe ual_list.txt ualinfo_*.txt search.log && ls -la probe2501.tgz && "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" probe2501.tgz 2501/probe2501.tgz
